title: Comfort mentions and settings not staying saved
summary: This topic mixes clear praise for long-drive comfort with many ambiguous snippets about settings, calls, navigation, and items not staying in place.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise ride comfort on longer drives and express appreciation for climate-control usability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention settings not staying synced or saved, calls not staying connected, and other unclear 'stay' references without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects linked by the word 'stay,' including comfort, climate controls, saved settings, phone calls, dealer visits, navigation, and storage behavior.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too brief to establish a clear customer evaluation.
Some potentially negative-sounding details appear in fragments assigned to positive reviews, so they cannot be used as evidence for negative sentiment here.
